{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (e.g., >70% above recent mean) by 10-20% in next 3-5 days.",
    "Adjust downward bias in forecasts when sentiment history shows negative sentiment (e.g., -0.25 or below) for 3+ consecutive days.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast deviates >1.5σ from 30-day moving average, revert toward average by 5-15% over next 5 days.",
    "Increase downward bias in forecasts when sentiment history shows positive sentiment (e.g., >0.5) and price is trending downward.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility in low-sentiment periods (e.g., sentiment <0.25) by smoothing 30-day forecast with 15-day moving average.",
    "Correct for lagged forecasts: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast 3-5 days prior, adjust next forecast downward by 5-10%.",
    "Apply upward correction if true outcome is significantly higher than forecast 3-5 days prior, especially if sentiment is neutral or positive."
  ]
}
